text:
maria.p: Quick sync — Q3 planning for Optimize toolkit (batching/caching recs, promptset evals). We have three strong customer asks and limited dev bandwidth. Need to pick GA vs beta and finalize launch criteria.

alex.k: What are the asks exactly?

maria.p: 1) per-route batching recommendations + config UI
2) KV/prefix caching suggestion engine (recommend TTLs, auto-apply opt-in)
3) promptset regression alerts + historical baselines for evals

nina.l: Backend note: dynamic batching exists; per-route shaping requires per-route queue windows + metrics. Est ~2 sprints. KV suggestion engine is mostly telemetry + simple heuristics, ~1 sprint.

sam.r: Evals work to do: promptset infra (storage + versioning), diffing metrics, and a service to trigger alerts when quality drops beyond threshold. That's ~3 sprints if we want reliable autosuggest + basic UI.

jordan.t: From customers I've talked to, priority order is: batching recs > cache suggestions > regression alerts. Latency wins are tangible for them. Regression alerts are a nice-to-have for early adopters.

maria.p: Proposal: GA scope = batching recommendations + KV cache suggestions + full docs/examples + quickstart. Beta = promptset library + regression auto-alerts (opt-in). Launch criteria proposal: 
- measurable unit econ: >=15% median p95 token cost reduction for targeted workloads (or customer-specific thresholds)
- 3 reference customers run in production (beta->ga signoff)
- SDK + Console flows validated with e2e tests
- Internal runbook for fallback + rollback

alex.k: Agree on split but we need clear test harness for the perf target. Suggest we codify workload classes and include a small script to run baseline vs optimized:
```bash
# example perf check (local harness)
python perf_harness.py --model redwood-1 --workload bursty --before baseline.json --after optimized.json
```
This should output p50/p95 cost+latency deltas.

nina.l: Also add a gating metric for correctness/regression: automated evals must show no regression >2% on key prompts. That prevents caching/batching heuristics from degrading quality.

sam.r: For beta prompts/regressions we can ship a minimal UI that shows diffs and tags failing prompts. Auto-rollback is risky — start with alerts + manual rollback recommendation.

maria.p: Owners: alex.k -> batching API + Console wiring, nina.l -> KV suggestion engine + heuristics, sam.r -> evals infra + promptset MVP, jordan.t -> customer validation & 3 reference programs. Timeline request: aim for GA launch in 10 weeks if we prioritize GA items and run the others in parallel as beta.

jordan.t: I'll pull 3 customers for validation, can start next week.

alex.k: Can we do an initial cut in 4 weeks for the API + telemetry so customers can trial?

maria.p: Yes — 4-week milestone = telemetry + recommendation engine demo + docs draft. 10-week GA if all gates pass.

release-bot: draft-release-notes created for branch optimize-toolkit/optimize-2026-q3 (ID: #4521).

maria.p: Next steps: owners confirm sprint capacity by EOD Friday. If we hit resource constraints, we drop automated regression alerts from GA and move them to beta. :thumbsup:

alex.k: I'll confirm capacity. If we need to trim scope, prefer trimming UI polish not core heuristics.

nina.l: Same, will prioritize core heuristics.

sam.r: Will scope promptset MVP to tagging + diff view only. No auto-rollback in MVP.

maria.p: Great — I'll update the deck and OKR draft to reflect GA vs Beta split and add the gating metrics. Thanks everyone.
